item.title: Trees overgrowing, obstructing the way, 7th October
item.description:
Hi, There are two young trees with overgrown branches growing from the ground, which are obstructing the pathway and reducing visibility for pedestrians. The branches are also trapping rubbish underneath and around them. Could someone please come and trim the overgrown branches, remove the rubbish, and help maintain a cleaner and safer street? This is a very busy and frequently used street, so it would be greatly appreciated if this could be addressed. Many thanks.

Nearest address to the pin placed on the map (from OS Places API): Harrow Manorway, Abbey Wood

item.title: Abandoned car opposite my driveway & parked on the pavement, with no TAX since 2024, 7th October
item.description:
Location: Kevington Drive / Parked on the pavement, Orpington (BR5) Timeframe: Abandoned and unmoved for over 4 weeks Vehicle Details: • Registration Number: BK63SZN • Make & Model: Vauxhall Mokka • Year: 2013 • Colour: Black Description of Issue: This vehicle is completely abandoned and has been left parked directly across the public pavement for the last 4 weeks. It creates a severe and immediate highway safety hazard by entirely blocking the footway, forcing all pedestrians—including children, parents with prams, and elderly residents—to walk out into the live road to bypass it. Furthermore, A check of the vehicle's history confirms it has had no valid road tax since 2024, meaning it has been illegally kept on a public highway for up to two years. Please arrange for immediate parking enforcement inspection and emergency vehicle removal.
Nearest road to the pin placed on the map (automatically generated by OpenStreetMap): 55, Kevington Drive, St Paul's Cray, Orpington, Greater London
